title: MealResponse
description: Response body of POST /meal/photo and POST /meal/text.

items.description: Detected foods. Empty when no food was found (see warnings).

warnings.description: Problems the app should tell the user about. Empty when there are none.

items.description: no_food_detected: nothing edible found. image_unclear: photo too blurry or dark to be sure. mixed_dish: a stew, soup or similar where ingredients and grams are rough guesses. text_unclear: part of the sentence could not be turned into foods.
